scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @esl/core && npm run build --workspace @esl/i18n && npm run build --workspace @esl/server && npm run build --workspace @esl/cli && npm run build --workspace @esl/web
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build --workspace @esl/web && docker compose up -d server
scripts.initialize:permissions: npm run build --workspace @esl/core && npm run build --workspace @esl/server && npm run initialize:permissions --workspace @esl/server
scripts.reload:dev: npm run build && docker compose build api && docker compose up -d api server
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @esl/core && vitest run && npm test --workspace @esl/web
